WITH freq_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    a.frequency,
    AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) as avg_signed_amount,
    AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance
  FROM trans t
  INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
  GROUP BY a.frequency
),
mean_signed AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) as mean_avg_signed
  FROM freq_stats
),
above_mean AS (
  SELECT 
    fs.avg_signed_amount,
    fs.avg_balance,
    fs.avg_signed_amount - ms.mean_avg_signed as excess
  FROM freq_stats fs
  CROSS JOIN mean_signed ms
  WHERE fs.avg_signed_amount > ms.mean_avg_signed
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_signed_amount) as avg_signed_average,
  AVG(avg_balance) as avg_balance_average,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_mean
